caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron structure, likely a decorative window guard or balcony grille, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The structure consists of vertical iron bars framed by horizontal and slightly curved crossbars at the top and bottom. Each vertical bar is colored in dark brown with subtle black accents, giving a metallic appearance. Ornamental scrollwork in a similar color is present at regular intervals—both at the ends of the horizontal bars and at several points along the bars themselves—creating symmetrical patterns. At the top center of the grille, there is a more elaborate fleur-de-lis ornament. The drawing shows no additional objects, and the structure is presented in full detail with shading that suggests three-dimensionality. The artist's signature, "W. Kleukens," is visible in small letters near the lower right corner.
title: Iron Grille
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
